act.line: TFR 6/1111 in force when you get there: route around it, or go later
act.lead: TFR 6/1111 in force when you get there
act.action: Route around it, or go later
act.why: A TFR is airspace closed by NOTAM, and flying through one in force breaks 14 CFR 91.137 (or 91.141 round the President); a restricted area in use is closed under 91.133, and a MOA can be busy with no NOTAM at all.

act.line: 2.3 gal short of the fuel and its 30 min reserve (14 CFR 91.151): add fuel, or plan a stop
act.lead: 2.3 gal short of the fuel and its 30 min reserve (14 CFR 91.151)
act.action: Add fuel, or plan a stop
act.why: A VFR flight may only set out with fuel to its first landing and 30 minutes more by day, 45 at night (14 CFR 91.151); under IFR it is fuel to the alternate and 45 minutes more (91.167). Planning to fly into the reserve is a no-go, not a margin.

act.line: AIRMET Sierra along the route: read it on En Route and plan around it
act.action: Read it on En Route and plan around it
act.why: VFR needs 14 CFR 91.155's visibility and distance from clouds all the way; a briefer's "VFR not recommended" (AIM 7-1-5) means the forecast is under them somewhere on the route, and your own minimums are stricter still.

act.line: VFR not recommended: KDLH currently reporting IFR with ceilings of 400 ft and visibility of a hal…: wait for it to lift, or plan another day
act.lead: VFR not recommended: KDLH currently reporting IFR with ceilings of 400 ft and visibility of a half mile in fog, KDLH currently reporting IFR with ceilings of 400 ft and visibility of a half mile in fog, KDLH currently reporting IFR with ceilings of 400 ft and visibility of a half mile in fog
act.action: Wait for it to lift, or plan another day
act.why: VFR needs 14 CFR 91.155's visibility and distance from clouds all the way; a briefer's "VFR not recommended" (AIM 7-1-5) means the forecast is under them somewhere on the route, and your own minimums are stricter still.

act.line: Ceiling 11,700 ft: terrain 40 nm past KDLH needs 12,500: pick another altitude or route
act.lead: Ceiling 11,700 ft: terrain 40 nm past KDLH needs 12,500
act.why: Above 3,000 ft AGL a VFR cruise follows the hemispheric rule (14 CFR 91.159), 91.119 sets the least height over terrain and people, and the altitude must keep 91.155's distance from the clouds.

act.line: 120 lb over the maximum takeoff weight: move or leave some weight
act.lead: 120 lb over the maximum takeoff weight
act.why: Outside the envelope the airplane may not climb, or may not answer the controls; 14 CFR 91.9 forbids flying outside the flight manual's limits, and 91.103 asks you to know all about the flight before you go.
